# Settings

<!-- Generated by tools/settings_reference.py; edit that file, not this one. -->

Every setting the framework reads: where you can set it, its default, and what it does.
`tests/test_settings_reference.py` fails when the code reads a setting this page does not list.

## Where settings come from

Highest first: your shell's environment, then `.env` in your project root (in a framework clone, its root), then the machine file `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/striim-test/machine.env` (or the file `SLT_MACHINE_ENV` names). The **Where** column says which of them a setting is read from:

- **shell**: only from the environment. In `.env` it is not read.
- **`.env`**: from the environment or `.env`.
- **machine**: from the machine file too. Paths, ports, the stack prefix and `STRIIM_URL` are never read from it, so two checkouts on one machine stay apart; license keys are read from the shell or the machine file only, never `.env`.

Start from your repository's `.env.example`. `striim-test doctor` lists the settings that are set and where each came from.

## Striim

| Setting | Where | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `STRIIM_URL` | shell, `.env` | unset: Docker mode | Root URL of your own Striim server, with no path. Unset, a run builds and starts a Striim cluster in Docker. |
| `STRIIM_USER` | shell, `.env`, machine | `admin` | A Striim user allowed to create and drop apps. |
| `STRIIM_PASS` | shell, `.env`, machine | the Docker cluster's, `striim` | That user's password. |
| `STRIIM_PASSWORD` | shell, `.env`, machine |  | Another name for `STRIIM_PASS`. |
| `STRIIM_API_TIMEOUT` | shell, `.env`, machine | `10,600` | Timeout on Striim REST calls, in seconds: `600` (read), `10,600` (connect,read), or `0` for none. Login and read-only polls use `10,120`; jar LOAD and UNLOAD use none. |
| `STRIIM_HOME` | shell | unset: Striim 5.4.2 | A Striim install. Docker mode builds its image from this install's release and reads the license from its `conf/startUp.properties`; Open Processor and UDF jars compile against it. |
| `COMPANY_NAME` | shell, machine |  | Docker mode's license, with the next three, when `STRIIM_HOME` is unset or has no license: `CompanyName` in `startUp.properties`. |
| `CLUSTER_NAME` | shell, machine |  | License: `WAClusterName`. |
| `PRODUCT_KEY` | shell, machine |  | License: `ProductKey`. |
| `LICENCE_KEY` | shell, machine |  | License: `LicenceKey`. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_VIEW_HOST` | shell, `.env`, machine | `localhost`; `host.docker.internal` for the Docker cluster | The host Striim reaches every service by. Set it when your Striim reaches them under another name, such as a Striim in a Docker container of your own. |
| `SLT_SERVICES_HOST` | shell | `localhost` | The host the Docker cluster is reached on. With `STRIIM_URL` unset, Striim's URL is `http://<this host>:9080`. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_NATIVE_ONLY` | shell | unset | `1`: use only the Striim at `STRIIM_URL`; fail rather than start a Striim in Docker. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_BOOT_WAIT` | shell | `300` | Seconds to wait for a starting Docker cluster to accept a login. |
| `SLT_CLUSTER_SETTLE` | shell | `20` | Seconds to let a just-formed Docker cluster settle before the first deploy. |

## Ownership and cleanup

| Setting | Where | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SLT_INFRA_OWNERSHIP` | shell, `.env`, machine | unset: a run refuses to start | `shared`: reuse what is running, start what is missing, never tear it down (needs `SLT_KEEP_SERVICES=1`). `exclusive`: take a fresh stack, refuse if a Striim already answers, and tear everything down at the end. |
| `SLT_KEEP_SERVICES` | shell, `.env`, machine | unset | `1`: keep the cluster and service containers after the run. Required with `shared`. |
| `SLT_KEEP_RESOURCES` | shell | unset | `1`: keep each test's app, tables and slots whatever the result (`--keep-resources`). |
| `SLT_KEEP_RESOURCES_ON_ERROR` | shell | unset | `1`: the same, for failed tests only. Replication slots are dropped; the teardown prints the SQL that recreates them. |
| `SLT_ALLOW_NO_CLUSTER` | shell | unset | `1`: do not fail a run in which every case skipped for missing infrastructure. |

## Where things are

| Setting | Where | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GOLD_TARGETS` | shell | unset: the framework clone's own cases | Your project manifest, `gold-targets.yaml`; the same as `--targets`. |
| `SLT_PROJECT_ROOT` | shell, `.env` | the clone root | The project: case ids, `example:` and `jar:` paths are relative to it, and its `.env` is the one read. Only the shell's value says where that `.env` is. |
| `SLT_FRAMEWORK_HOME` | shell, `.env` | the clone's `scripts/` | The framework checkout. |
| `SLT_LIVE_CASES` | shell, `.env` | `scripts/live/regression` | The live case root, or several separated by `:` (`;` on Windows). `striim-test run PATH` runs only cases under it. |
| `SLT_INT_CASES` | shell, `.env` | the clone's integration cases | The integration case root. |
| `SLT_SERVICES_DIR` | shell, `.env` | `scripts/live/services` | Live service definitions. |
| `SLT_INT_SERVICES_DIR` | shell, `.env` | `scripts/integration/services` | Integration service definitions. |
| `SLT_STATE_DIR` | shell, `.env` | `scripts/live` | Run directories and coordination files. |
| `SLT_MACHINE_ENV` | shell | `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/striim-test/machine.env` | The machine-wide settings file. |
| `SLT_FRAMEWORK_DOTENV` | shell | the clone's `.env` | A file to read as the framework clone's `.env`, when `SLT_PROJECT_ROOT` is not set. |
| `SLT_LOCK_DIR` | shell | `/tmp/slt-locks` | The coordination directory every run on the machine shares (mode 1777). |

## Running

| Setting | Where | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SLT_PARALLEL` | shell | unset | `1`: allow pytest-xdist (`-n`) and give each test its own name tokens. `striim-test run --parallel` sets it. |
| `SLT_RUN_DISABLED` | shell | unset | `1`: run tests marked `disabled:` or `disabled_parallel:`. |
| `SLT_SKIP_VERIFY` | shell | unset | `1`: run each test until it is RUNNING with its data flowed, then skip every assertion and the `recover:` phase and report it skipped. For debugging by hand, with `SLT_KEEP_RESOURCES=1`. |
| `SLT_EMULATORS` | shell | unset | `1`: opt in to every service that declares `opt_in_env`. |
| `SLT_PRE_UP` | shell, `.env`, machine | unset | `0`: turn off every service's `pre_up` hook. |
| `SLT_OP_RETRY_FAILED` | shell | unset | `1`: retry loading an Open Processor jar that already failed twice at the same bytes in this run. |
| `SLT_RECOVER_RESTORE_TIMEOUT` | shell | `600` | Seconds a `recover:` phase allows for its restore. |
| `SLT_STACK_PREFIX` | shell, `.env` | unset | Run a second, independent stack on the same machine: its containers and cleanup carry this prefix. |
| `SLT_JDK<release>_HOME` | shell | on macOS, the JDK `java_home` finds | The JDK that builds Open Processor and UDF jars for that Java release, for example `SLT_JDK17_HOME`. Off macOS the JDK comes only from here. |

## The Docker Striim cluster

| Setting | Where | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SLT_STRIIM_PRIMARY_CPUS` | shell, `.env`, machine | `0` | CPUs the primary node may use; `0` is no limit. The license caps the CPUs a cluster counts (24 in the tested licenses), and each node counts every CPU it sees, so on a machine with more than 12 CPUs cap both nodes, for example 12 each. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_NODE_CPUS` | shell, `.env`, machine | `0` | CPUs the second node may use; `0` is no limit. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_MEM_MAX` | shell, `.env`, machine | `16384m` | Java heap of each node. Lower it on a modest machine or before running several stacks. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_MEM_LIMIT` | shell, `.env`, machine | `0` | Memory limit of each node's container; `0` is no limit. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_JAVA_SYSTEM_PROPERTIES` | shell, `.env`, machine |  | Extra Java system properties for the nodes, for example `-Djava.awt.headless=true`. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_DEPS_MANIFEST` | shell | unset | A manifest of the Striim installers you already have, to skip the 6.3 GB download ([RUN-YOUR-FIRST-TEST.md](RUN-YOUR-FIRST-TEST.md) has the format). |
| `SLT_STRIIM_MIN_FREE_GB` | shell | `35` | Free Docker disk, in GB, a first image build requires. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_HTTP_HOST_PORT` | shell, `.env` | `9080` | Host port of the console and REST API. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_HTTPS_HOST_PORT` | shell, `.env` | `9081` | Host port of HTTPS. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_JMX_HOST_PORT` | shell, `.env` | `7071` | Host port of the primary's JMX Prometheus exporter. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_NODE_JMX_HOST_PORT` | shell, `.env` | `7075` | Host port of the second node's JMX exporter. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_AGENT_JMX_HOST_PORT` | shell, `.env` | `7076` | Host port of the agent's JMX exporter. |
| `SLT_STRIIM_DEBUG_HOST_PORT` | shell, `.env` | `8787` | Host port of the primary's JDWP remote debugger. |

## Services

To use your own database instead of the container the framework starts, set its host (the first row); the other settings default to the container's values, shown here. [SERVICES.md](SERVICES.md) has each service's accounts, tokens and routes.

### GCS emulator (`gcs`)

| Setting | Where | Docker default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SLT_GCS_HOST` | shell, `.env`, machine | `localhost` | Your own instance's host: set it to use that instead of the container. |
| `SLT_GCS_PORT` | shell, `.env`, machine | `4443` | Your own instance: its port. |
| `SLT_GCS_PROJECT` | shell, `.env`, machine | `test-project` | Your own instance: the project id. |
| `SLT_GCS_SRC_BUCKET` | shell, `.env`, machine | `slt-src` | Your own instance: the bucket source objects go in. |
| `SLT_GCS_TGT_BUCKET` | shell, `.env`, machine | `slt-tgt` | Your own instance: the bucket target objects go in. |
| `SLT_GCS_HOST_PORT` | shell, `.env` | `4443` | Host port the container publishes; change it when the port is in use. |
| `SLT_GCS_TOKEN_HOST_PORT` | shell, `.env` | `4444` | Host port the container publishes for the fake OAuth token server's port; change it when the port is in use. |
| `SLT_GCS_CPUS` | shell, `.env`, machine | `0.5` | CPUs the container may use. |
| `SLT_GCS_EXTERNAL_URL` | shell, `.env`, machine | `http://0.0.0.0:${SLT_GCS_HOST_PORT:-4443}` | The URL the emulator gives out for its own objects. |
| `SLT_GCS_MEM_LIMIT` | shell, `.env`, machine | `512m` | Memory limit of the container. |
| `SLT_GCS_PUBLIC_HOST` | shell, `.env`, machine | `host.docker.internal:${SLT_GCS_HOST_PORT:-4443}` | The host name the emulator gives out for its own objects. |
| `SLT_TOKEN_CPUS` | shell, `.env`, machine | `0.5` | CPUs the container may use. |
| `SLT_TOKEN_MEM_LIMIT` | shell, `.env`, machine | `512m` | Memory limit of the container. |
| `SLT_GCS_VIEW_HOST` | shell, `.env`, machine |  | The host Striim reaches it by, when that differs from this machine's. |

## Integration tier

The integration engine's own settings ([INTEGRATION-TESTS.md](INTEGRATION-TESTS.md)), then its services'.

| Setting | Where | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INT_STACK_PREFIX` | shell, `.env` | unset | Run a second integration stack on the same machine, with its own containers and state. |
| `INT_KEEP_SERVICES` | shell | unset | `1`: leave the service containers running after the session, for fast local iteration. |
| `INT_KEEP_RESOURCES` | shell | unset | `1`: keep each case's resources after it runs. |
| `INT_EMULATORS` | shell | unset | `1`: opt in to every integration service that declares `opt_in_env`. |
| `INT_VARIANT` | shell | unset: every variant | Run only this variant of each case, to iterate on one engine without starting every database. A name no case defines runs nothing. |
| `INT_EXTRA_CLASSPATH` | shell | unset | Jars added to the harness classpath, such as a JDBC driver kept elsewhere. |
| `INT_PG_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_RESET` | shell | unset | `1`: allow the Postgres reset, a cascading drop of the test schemas, on a database other than the sandbox `intdb`. |
| `INT_ALLOW_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS` | shell | unset | `1`: allow a second integration session on the same stack at the same time. |
| `INT_SHARED_SERVICES` | shell | unset | Reserved: a broker owns the services, and the session does not tear them down. |

## Set by the framework

The framework sets these for its own processes. Do not set them.

| Names | What they carry |
|---|---|
| `SLT_FRAMEWORK_MODE` | how `striim-test` started the engine |
| `SLT_RUN_EPOCH`, `SLT_RUN_IDENTITY` | the run's id and its `identity.json`, shared by every engine process of one run |
| `SLT_INVOCATION_ID` | the id of one engine process, recorded in its evidence |
| `STRIIM_TEST_GUARD` | marks a pytest that `striim-test` started |
| `SLT_OPS_PRELOADED`, `SLT_PREFLIGHT_ATTEMPT`, `SLT_PREFLIGHT_CLEANUP_SERVICES`, `SLT_PREFLIGHT_OUTCOMES_PATH` | the pre-flight that loads shared Open Processors once before parallel runs |
| `SLT_SERVICE_DIR`, `SLT_LIVE_SERVICE_DIR`, `SLT_FRAMEWORK_PYTHON` | given to a service's `pre_up` hook ([YOUR-OWN-SERVICES.md](YOUR-OWN-SERVICES.md)) |
| `SLT_LIFECYCLE_FAULT` | fault injection for the framework's own lifecycle tests |

## Retired names

A run refuses these and names the setting that replaced them.

| Retired | Use |
|---|---|
| `SLT_FRAMEWORK` | `SLT_FRAMEWORK_HOME` |
| `SLT_MODE` | `SLT_FRAMEWORK_MODE` |
